---
title: "Hans Rosling Gapminder World Chart"
format:
  html:
    fig-width: 10
    fig-height: 6.5
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, gapminder, ggrepel, scales)
```

```{r}
#| label: rosling-chart
# Gapminder continent color palette:
# Africa: cyan, Americas: green, Asia: red, Europe: yellow, Oceania: turquoise
gapminder_colors <- c(
  "Africa"   = "#00D5E9",
  "Americas" = "#7FEB00",
  "Asia"     = "#FF5872",
  "Europe"   = "#FFE700",
  "Oceania"  = "#00E5C9"
)

labeled_countries <- c(
  "China", "India", "United States", "Indonesia", 
  "Brazil", "Nigeria", "Japan", "Latvia"
)

gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, y = lifeExp)) +
  # Background year watermark
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2000,
    y = 50,
    label = "2007",
    size = 45,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "gray90",
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0.5
  ) +
  # Bubble marks: size by area, thin border
  geom_point(
    aes(size = pop, fill = continent),
    shape = 21,
    color = "gray20",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  # Direct labels on key countries
  geom_text_repel(
    data = \(df) filter(df, country %in% labeled_countries),
    aes(label = country),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "gray15",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "gray50",
    segment.size = 0.3
  ) +
  # Area scaling for bubble population
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 28,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  # Logarithmic x-axis
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(400, 1000, 2000, 4000, 10000, 20000, 40000, 100000),
    labels = scales::dollar_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(300, 120000)
  ) +
  # Linear y-axis for life expectancy
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(20, 90, by = 10),
    limits = c(30, 88)
  ) +
  # Continent fill palette
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = gapminder_colors,
    name = "Continent"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "This is the graph that YOU will make!",
    subtitle = "Wealth and Health of Nations (2007)\nGross domestic product per capita versus life expectancy at birth",
    x = "Income per person (GDP per capita in USD, Purchasing Power Parity, log scale)",
    y = "Life expectancy at birth (years)",
    caption = "Source: Gapminder Foundation (gapminder R package)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6, alpha = 1))
  )
```
